title.zh: 气候反馈 · 放大或削弱初始升温
title.en: Climate feedbacks · amplifying or damping the first warming

description.zh: CO₂ 先让地球散热变难、带来一点初始升温；升温又让冰雪变少（反射的阳光减少）、空气里水汽变多（多吸红外），它们再推高温度——这些回路把一个小扰动放大，直到进出的能量重新平衡。
description.en: CO₂ first makes it harder for the Earth to shed heat, causing some initial warming; that warming melts snow and ice (less sunlight reflected) and puts more water vapour in the air (more infrared absorbed), which push the temperature higher still — loops that amplify a small push until incoming and outgoing energy balance again.

zh: 全球变暖为什么会加速

reason.zh: 短波进来、红外出去，两者相等时温度稳定；温室气体让“出去”变难，地球就升温，直到顶端的进出重新相等——反馈改变的正是这本账。
reason.en: Shortwave light comes in and infrared goes out, and the temperature is steady when they match; greenhouse gases make going out harder, so the Earth warms until the top-of-atmosphere ledger balances again — feedbacks change that very ledger.

label.zh: 排放只有一部分留在空气里
label.en: Only part of the emissions stays in the air

reason.zh: 每年排出的碳一部分被海洋和陆地吸收，其余留在大气；被吸收不等于消失——海洋会酸化，陆地吸收还受温度和水分限制。
reason.en: Of the carbon emitted each year, part is taken up by the ocean and land and the rest stays in the air; taken up is not gone — the ocean acidifies, and land uptake is limited by temperature and water.

label.zh: 回路的符号决定放大还是削弱
label.en: A loop’s sign decides amplify or damp

reason.zh: “变化 → 机制 → 下一步变化”沿回路走一圈，如果把原来的变化推得更大就是正反馈（冰雪、水汽），推回去就是负反馈（升温多散热）；控制系统里同样用回路的符号判断稳不稳。
reason.en: Go once round “change → mechanism → next change”: if it pushes the original change further it is positive feedback (ice, water vapour), if it pushes back it is negative (a warmer Earth radiates more); control systems judge stability by the same sign of the loop.
